display.purpose: Page-level h1 headings. Feed, Exercise, Library, Profile screen titles.

headline.purpose: Section headings inside the main content area. 'Ideas worth sharing'.

title.purpose: Article card h3 titles, card section headers.

body.purpose: All supporting copy. Activity feeds, descriptions, metadata.

label.purpose: Table column headers (uppercase+tracked), timestamps, tag text, progress deltas.

shadows.name: ambient-low
shadows.purpose: All cards, inputs, ghost buttons at rest.

shadows.name: ambient-high
shadows.purpose: Elevated overlays: NavDock, dropdowns, QuoteStack front card.

shadows.name: action-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary button only. Blue-tinted glow. The only colored shadow in the system.

motion.name: ease-expressive
motion.purpose: Standard easing for all enter/exit transitions: card crossfades, dropdown reveals, article card enter/exit.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main call-to-action. Read more, Start climbing, Study. Blue background, blue action glow.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">Read more <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 12h14"/><path d="m12 5 7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #3b82f6; color: #fff; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; padding: 10px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0px 13.674px 19.206px 0px rgba(59,130,246,0.28); transition: background 0.15s; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2563eb; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3b82f6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions: Edit profile, Import, filter icon buttons. White background, ambient shadow.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M17 3a2.85 2.83 0 1 1 4 4L7.5 20.5 2 22l1.5-5.5Z"/></svg> Edit profile</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #ffffff; color: #404040; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; padding: 8px 14px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0px 5.492px 5.492px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0px 1.098px 3.295px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #fafafa; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3b82f6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tint Button
components.description: Soft in-card actions: View all activity, View stats, Apply filters. No shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-tint { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; background: #e5f3fe; color: #3b82f6; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-tint:hover { background: #d6e8fd; } .ds-btn-tint:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3b82f6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The universal surface. White, 16–24px radius, ambient-low shadow. Main content cards use p-6; sidebar cards use p-5.
components.html:
Card title

Supporting content goes here, at 13px with 1.6 line-height.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0px 5.492px 5.492px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0px 1.098px 3.295px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); } .ds-card-title { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #171717; } .ds-card-body { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; color: #737373; line-height: 1.6; margin-top: 8px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: White, rounded-2xl, ambient-low shadow, embedded icon button. Used in page headers.
components.css: .ds-input-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 16px; padding: 10px 16px; width: 320px; box-shadow: 0px 5.492px 5.492px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0px 1.098px 3.295px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); } .ds-input-search__icon { flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-input-search__field { flex: 1; background: transparent; border: none; outline: none; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #404040; } .ds-input-search__field::placeholder { color: #a3a3a3; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Semantic state chip. Tint background + icon + label. Variants: pending (coral), inProgress (blue), success (green), inReview (amber).
components.html: In progress
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; } .ds-badge--inprogress { background: #e5f3fe; color: #008dff; } .ds-badge--success { background: #e1fae8; color: #37c25c; } .ds-badge--pending { background: #fff4ee; color: #e68f38; } .ds-badge--inreview { background: #fcf4db; color: #e6961f; } .ds-badge--failed { background: #fdefee; color: #ec6a5b; }

components.name: NavDock
components.description: Fixed bottom navigation. White/90 frosted glass container, 4 items, spring-animated active pill.
components.html: <nav class="ds-navdock"><button class="ds-navdock__item ds-navdock__item--active"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 22V12l8-8 8 8v10"/><path d="M9 22V12h6v10"/></svg> Feed</button><button class="ds-navdock__item"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m6.5 6.5 11 11"/><path d="M21 12a9 9 0 1 1-18 0 9 9 0 0 1 18 0"/></svg> Exercise</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-navdock { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-radius: 16px; padding: 6px; box-shadow: 0px 13.18px 7.688px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.02), 0px 5.492px 5.492px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0px 1.098px 3.295px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); } .ds-navdock__item { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; border: none; background: transparent; border-radius: 12px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #737373; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-navdock__item--active { background: #3b82f6; color: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0px 8px 16px 0px rgba(59,130,246,0.28); } .ds-navdock__item:not(.ds-navdock__item--active):hover { color: #171717; }

components.name: Tinted Icon Chip
components.description: 36×36px rounded-xl chip: semantic tint bg, semantic color icon. Used in activity feeds, progress rows, exercise session cards.
components.css: .ds-icon-chip { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-icon-chip--blue   { background: #e5f3fe; color: #3b82f6; } .ds-icon-chip--green  { background: #e1fae8; color: #37c25c; } .ds-icon-chip--amber  { background: #fcf4db; color: #e6961f; } .ds-icon-chip--coral  { background: #fff4ee; color: #ec6a5b; }

narrative.overview:
Reader & Writer is the design of a well-organized, quiet workspace — the kind that belongs to someone who reads with a pencil in hand. Everything on screen is there because it earns its presence. The canvas (#f2f2f2) is the desk surface: warm enough to feel physical, neutral enough to disappear behind the content. Cards are white sheets of paper stacked at rest. The accent is a single, clear blue — informational, never decorative — used precisely where the eye needs guidance.

This is explicitly not a gamified learning tool. There are no confetti explosions, no mascots, no loop-closure pressure mechanics. Progress stats live in the sidebar like a quietly updated scoreboard — available when you look, invisible when you don't.

The motion energy is responsive: state changes and transitions only, no choreographed entrances. Springs handle active-pill nav transitions; crossfades handle card swaps. Every animation has a prefers-reduced-motion alternative.
keyCharacteristics: Off-white canvas (#f2f2f2) with pure-white cards — depth through layering, not shadows
Single accent color (Focus Blue #3b82f6); semantic secondaries for data states only
Rounded-but-not-bubbly: 16–24px on cards, 12–16px on controls, 999px on tags/pills only
Tight, tracked display type; comfortable 13px body; 11px uppercase tracking for labels
Ambient shadow vocabulary — diffuse, layered — never structural or directional
Data richness tucked into the sidebar; reading surface kept free

rules.name: The Single Voice Rule
rules.body: Focus Blue appears on ≤10% of any screen surface. Its rarity communicates meaning. Semantic secondaries appear only in data-state chips — never as button colors or section backgrounds.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: No second typeface is introduced. No serifs, no display faces, no mono for decorative use. One family, varied by weight. If a surface needs to feel more editorial, increase weight and decrease size.

rules.name: The Flatness Rule
rules.body: Shadows are ambient, never directional. The two-layer ambient formula is the only permitted shadow structure. Cards do not acquire shadows on hover.

dos: Do use white cards on the #f2f2f2 canvas as the primary depth mechanism.
Do use Focus Blue only on primary CTAs, the active nav state, active tab indicators, and selected states.
Do pair tint backgrounds with their semantic foreground color consistently.
Do use the two-layer ambient shadow formula verbatim for all cards.
Do include prefers-reduced-motion alternatives for every animation.
Do keep body copy at 13px with 1.6 line-height on a 65ch max-width on reading surfaces.
donts: Don't use borderLeft greater than 1px as a colored stripe on cards or list items.
Don't animate layout properties — springs and crossfades on transform and opacity only.
Don't use gradient backgrounds, gradient text, or glassmorphism as decoration.
Don't build Duolingo-style reward mechanics: no confetti, no celebration modals, no mascot icons.
Don't use heavy directional drop shadows. The ambient two-layer formula is the ceiling.
Don't use semantic colors on interactive controls — they are data-state colors only.
Don't use rounded-[32px+] on cards. 24px is the maximum.
